name: HDM to KiCad
description: Build a KiCad PCB from an HDM (Hardware Description Manifest) YAML file. Places footprints, assigns nets, and emits a board outline based on the HDM's project.dimensions. Schematic generation stays on the HDM pipeline's standalone emitter.
description_full: Companion plugin to the HDM → KiCad pipeline (hardware/hdm-to-kicad-pipeline). The pipeline turns Markdown design docs into an HDM YAML file; this plugin consumes that YAML from inside KiCad's PCB editor (or via KiCad's bundled Python interpreter) and materialises it as a .kicad_pcb — using pcbnew's Python API for geometry and net assignment, so KiCad's own validation passes cleanly.
